answer: Require every newcomer to enter through a single narrow inlet: two established agents must vouch for it by locking part of their own standing, slashed if the newcomer is caught cloning. Like tending an orchard, each vouch supports only a few saplings, so one operator cannot mass-produce identities without recruiting many real sponsors. A whisper of suspicion from any peer triggers a public audit where the newcomer must show a fresh chain of completed, paid work. Clones then cost real sponsor capital plus real work history, while honest agents enter cheaply on one vouch.
